This is an application for condoning the delay of 463 days in filing the appeal.
Notice of the application to the respondents.
Mr. Abhinash Jain, DAG, Haryana accepts notice on behalf of the respondent-State and submits that he does not wish to file reply to the same.

As per the averments made in the application, applicants are illiterate person having no knowledge about intricacies of law of limitation Nonetheless, the other similarly situated land owners pertaining to the same acquisition proceedings have already been held entitled for the enhanced amount of compensation pertaining to village Bhainsa Tibba to the tune of Rs.26,99,558/- per acre (Rs.558/- per sq. yard) vide judgment dated 1 of 4 Neutral Citation No:=2023:PHHC:090425 2023:PHHC:090425 RFA-774-2022(O&M) --2-- Jeet Ram vs State Of Haryana And Another on 18 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/124098224/

sentences.text: In view of the discussion made hereinabove, the application is allowed and delay of 463 days in filing the appeal is hereby condoned.
Main Appeal 1.

In the present case, land owned by the appellants situated in the revenue estate of village Bhainsa Tibba, Tehsil and District Panchkula, was acquired vide notification No.LAC(P)-NTLA-99/1181 dated 16.03.1999, issued under Section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (hereinafter referred to as "1894 Act"), followed by notification No.LAC(P)-NTLA- 2000/1593 dated 15.03.2000, under Section 6 of the Act, for the public purpose i.e. for development and utilization of the same as residential, commercial, institutional, recreational and so on in Sectors 1, 2, 3, 5B, 5C and 6,
Panchkula, extension of Mansa Devi Complex in Urban Estate, Panchkula.

Vide award No.8 dated 09.10.2003, the Land Acquisition Collector, fixed the market value of the acquired land situated in village Bhainsa Tibba at the rate of Rs.9 lakhs per acre for chahi-abi-barani land, Rs.5 lakhs per acre for banjar land and Rs.2.60 lakhs per acre for 2 of 4
Neutral
Citation No:=2023:PHHC:090425 2023:PHHC:090425 RFA-774-2022(O&M) --3-- gairmumkin land, besides other statutory benefits.

2. Aggrieved thereof, the appellants preferred separate references under Section 18 of the Act,
seeking enhancement of compensation, which was finally determined by reference Court vide judgment dated 20.09.2018 by fixing the market value of the acquired land situated at Village Bhainsa Tibba at the rate of Rs.511/- per square yard, besides granting other statutory benefits under the act.
3. Dissatisfied with the aforesaid judgment dated 20.09.2018, the appellants have preferred the present appeal for enhancement of compensation.

4. Learned counsel for the parties are ad idem that the matters pertaining to the same acquisition/notification covering the same revenue estate i.e. village Bhainsa Tibba filed at the instance of few other land- owners came up before this Court, which was disposed of vide judgment dated 10.08.2020 passed in CM-2247-CI-2020 in RFA-1638-2019, titled as "Fazal Mohd. (deceased)
through his Lrs and others vs. State of Haryana and another", Relevant part of Fazal Mohd.'s (deceased) case (supra) is reproduced hereunder:-
123(ii).

2 land of Bhainsa Tibba which falls on the other side of the railway line, towards Mani Majra and Village Kishangarh of Chandigarh, the market value is fixed @ 26,99,558/-
per acre (Rs.558/- per sq. yard) along with all statutory benefits by only allowing the appeals of the concerned set of landowners.

In view of the aforesaid discussion, the controversy being squarely covered with the aforesaid judgment, therefore, the present appeal is disposed of in the same terms as based on the agreed stand taken by both sides.

Based thereupon, applying the principle of parity, the land owners/applicants being similarly situated, are entitled for grant of similar amount of compensation, however, without any payment of interest for the period they failed to approach this Court after the decision in the reference Court.
In the present case, land owned by the appellants situated in the revenue estate of village Bhainsa Tibba, Tehsil and District Panchkula, was acquired vide notification No.LAC(P)-NTLA-99/1181 dated 16.03.1999, issued under Section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (hereinafter referred to as "1894 Act"), followed by notification No.LAC(P)-NTLA- 2000/1593 dated 15.03.2000, under Section 6 of the Act, for the public purpose i.e. for development and utilization of the same as residential, commercial, institutional, recreational and so on in Sectors 1, 2, 3, 5B, 5C and 6,

opennyai_summary.decision:
In view of the discussion made hereinabove, the application is allowed and delay of 463 days in filing the appeal is hereby condoned.

For the notification dated 16.09.1999, the market value is fixed @ 498/- per sq. yard (Rs.24,10,320/- per acre) along with all statutory benefits.
The appeals filed by the State are accordingly, partly allowed and those of the other landowners are dismissed."
